pv41:1.1: Sāvatthi nāma nagaraṃ Himavantassa passato tattha āsuṃ dve kumārā rājaputtā ti me sutaṃ. || ||
pv41:2.1: Sammattā rajanīyesu kāmassādābhinandino paccuppanne sukhe giddhā na te passiṃsu 'nāgataṃ. || ||
pv41:3.1: Te cutā ca manussattā paralokaṃ ito gatā te 'dha {ghosenty' adissantā} pubbe dukkaṭam attano: || ||
pv41:4.1: Bahūsu vata santesu deyyadhamme upaṭṭhite nāsakkhimhā ca attānaṃ parittaṃ kātuṃ sukhāvahaṃ, || ||
pv41:5.1: Kiṃ tato pāpakaṃ assa yaṃ no rājakulā cutā upapannā pettivisayaṃ khuppipāsasamappitā. || ||
pv41:6.1: Sāmino idha hutvāna honti assāmino tahiṃ caranti khuppipāsāya manussā unnatonatā. || ||
pv41:7.1: Etam ādīnavaṃ ñatvā issaramadasambhavaṃ pahāya issaramadaṃ bhave saggagato naro kāyassa bhedā sappañño saggaṃ so upapajjatī ti. || ||
